column2: a vast Thai mountain range at blue dawn, layers of misty ridges like ink wash, a calm glowing pale-blue orb of light resting above the highest peak like a gentle guardian spirit, soft volumetric fog drifting, quiet and timeless, cinematic, wide locked-off shot with lots of sky

a small outdoor stage at night in Chiang Mai old town, warm paper lanterns strung overhead, rows of empty wooden chairs, a large screen glowing soft blue, temple roofs silhouetted behind, cosy and intimate
a lone small glowing pale-blue orb hovering above a wooden lectern on a dark empty stage, a single warm spotlight, dust motes in the beam, humble and new
a dark auditorium seen from the stage, hundreds of tiny warm lights glowing in the seats like fireflies, a feeling of a whole room lighting up with excitement, no visible people
a bright university classroom in the morning, rows of open laptops glowing on desks, a small glowing blue orb floating above each laptop, sunlight through tall windows, green trees outside
a chain of translucent glowing cubes linked by light threads floating across a quiet lecture hall, warm wood desks below, soft blue and gold light
a calm night river of light flowing toward the viewer, dozens of small glowing paper boats and lanterns converging into one bright stream, mountains in the distance
a night sky above dark misty mountains filled with hundreds of small glowing blue and gold orbs like fireflies drifting upward, magical and vast
a vast quiet library made of glowing crystal shelves stretching into the distance, countless softly lit glass pages and threads of light, blue and silver, peaceful archive
hundreds of small glowing orbs gathered in a gentle ring around a bright orb resting above a mountain peak at night, warm golden light, a family together
a huge modern exhibition hall in the afternoon, sunlight through a high glass and steel roof, a large stage with tall blue screens at the far end, empty and expectant
a modern conference stage with two empty designer chairs side by side, two glowing orbs floating above the chairs, blue stage lights and soft haze, an audience area in shadow
many glowing orbs connected by fine threads of light forming a living network above a stage, pulses of light travelling between them, blue and gold, hopeful
